summary.en: Supports the ribs and anchors back muscles.
summary.zh: 支撑肋骨，也是背部肌肉的附着支架。

detail.en: The thoracic vertebrae carry ribs and provide spinous and transverse attachment processes. The model merges them into one mesh, so individual spinal segments do not bend [M47] [M49].
detail.zh: 胸椎连接肋骨，棘突与横突供肌肉附着。模型将它们合并成一个网格，不能逐节弯曲 [M47] [M49]。

summary.en: Supports the lower trunk and anchors the erectors.
summary.zh: 支撑腰部，供竖脊肌与筋膜附着。

detail.en: Lumbar vertebrae lie between the thoracic spine and sacrum. Attachments shown here include representative tendinous/fascial connections rather than complete footprints [M47] [M49].
detail.zh: 腰椎位于胸椎与骶骨之间。这里标出的包括代表性的腱性或筋膜连接，不是全部附着面积 [M47] [M49]。

summary.en: Supports rib attachments of the back muscles.
summary.zh: 支撑背部肌肉的肋骨附着点。

detail.en: The manifest exports sternum, ribs and costal cartilages together as thorax. Back attachment markers use the posterior rib surfaces; no separate sternum or rib mesh is duplicated [M47].
detail.zh: 清单将胸骨、肋骨与肋软骨合并导出为 thorax。背部附着点用肋骨后面；没有重复绘制胸廓网格 [M47]。

summary.en: Receives pulls that position the shoulder blade.
summary.zh: 接受拉力，改变肩胛骨的位置。

detail.en: The scapular spine, medial border, inferior angle and infraspinous fossa give different muscles different pulling directions [M47] [M48].
detail.zh: 肩胛冈、内侧缘、下角和冈下窝，让不同肌肉产生不同方向的拉力 [M47] [M48]。

summary.en: Connects the shoulder girdle to the sternum.
summary.zh: 把肩带连到胸骨，接受上斜方肌的拉力。

detail.en: Upper trapezius inserts along the posterior border of the lateral clavicle. The sternoclavicular and acromioclavicular joints are simplified pivots in this model [M47].
detail.zh: 斜方肌降部止于锁骨外侧段后缘。模型的胸锁和肩锁关节是简化转轴 [M47]。

summary.en: Receives the latissimus, teres and cuff tendons.
summary.zh: 接受背阔肌、圆肌和肩袖的止腱。

detail.en: Latissimus inserts in the intertubercular groove floor, teres major on its medial lip, and the cuff on facets of the greater tubercle. These are distinct attachments [M47] [M48].
detail.zh: 背阔肌止于结节间沟底，大圆肌止于内侧唇，肩袖止于大结节的不同小面。这些不是同一个止点 [M47] [M48]。

summary.en: Anchors lower-back fascia and muscle tendons.
summary.zh: 为腰背筋膜与肌腱提供固定支架。

detail.en: The merged pelvis includes hip bones, sacrum and coccyx. Latissimus and the spinal erectors attach to the iliac crest and associated fascia/tendons; these markers are representative [M47].
detail.zh: 合并骨盆包含髋骨、骶骨和尾骨。背阔肌与竖脊肌连到髂嵴及相关筋膜、肌腱；标记仅代表附着区 [M47]。

summary.en: Anchors the upper trapezius on the back of the skull.
summary.zh: 在头骨后面供斜方肌降部附着。

detail.en: The true Z-Anatomy occipital bone is added from the pipeline reference skeleton because upper trapezius attaches to its external occipital protuberance and superior nuchal line. It is not the whole skull [M47].
detail.zh: 从管线参考骨骼补入真实 Z-Anatomy 枕骨：斜方肌降部连到枕外隆凸和上项线。它不是完整头骨 [M47]。

summary.en: Anchors levator scapulae and upper-back muscles.
summary.zh: 供肩胛提肌与上背肌肉附着。

detail.en: True Z-Anatomy C1–C7 reference meshes are merged into a selectable bone part. Levator attaches to C1–C4 transverse processes; rhomboid minor to the C7 spinous region, distinct from the levator attachment [M47].
detail.zh: 将真实 Z-Anatomy C1–C7 参考网格合成可选骨骼零件。肩胛提肌连到 C1–C4 横突，小菱形肌连到 C7 棘突区，两者位置不同 [M47]。

summary.en: Locates the back muscles on the whole reference body.
summary.zh: 在全身参考模型上定位背部肌肉。

detail.en: The low-detail skin surface comes from the same Z-Anatomy reference body. X-ray fades this shell; left and right mean the body’s own sides [S2].
detail.zh: 简化皮肤来自同一具 Z-Anatomy 参考人体。透视将轮廓调淡；左右指身体自身的左右 [S2]。
